instructions_to_main_agent: Use Playfair Display for all major headings and Manrope for body text. Make sure to import them via Google Fonts.
The primary Call To Action is phone. Use '(360) 513-4172' prominently. A floating Call Now button (visible on mobile) is required.

Section styling: Keep it 'Luxury + Trust'. Generous whitespace, no cluttered UI. Use the Dark Green (#1E3A2A) for a premium dark section (e.g., Why Choose Us or Footer), and Gold (#C8A44D) for accents/buttons.
Do NOT use default shadcn card borders unless they are extremely subtle (e.g., border-border/40). Better to use soft background colors (#F8F6F2) for contrast against white.
Ensure the hero has a dark gradient overlay so the headline 'Your Property Deserves Better Landscaping' is highly readable.
Services should be presented with high-quality imagery (use the provided URLs).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and interactive elements for testing.
